verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents only a generic import pipeline: assets placed in the project folder, including 'scenes', are imported automatically. It never names glTF, FBX, or USD, or says how cleanly they import, so support for these interchange formats is unevidenced. Import plugins are a developer building block for custom importers, not first-party support for these formats, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a technical artist, standard interchange formats — glTF, FBX, USD — import cleanly
